scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:appointment-concurrency: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx ../artifacts/api-server/src/lib/appointment-locks.test.ts && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx ../artifacts/api-server/src/lib/appointment-routes.test.ts
scripts.test:review-photo-privacy: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx ../artifacts/api-server/src/lib/review-photo-privacy.test.ts && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:review-photo-privacy
